decision: a hub restart sets every session's stateSince to the moment it starts, which is what the rows showed
why: after the 0.3.22 install all twenty rows read 45 min
evidence: Hub.start built each model with emptySession(now); listSessions after a restart: every stateSince 0.3 min old

decision: the row shows lastActiveAt, set by a message to Claude, a finished reply, a request, and the end or failure of a turn, and not by opening a session, an answered request, an idle_prompt notice or Claude Code exiting
why: he asked for the time of the last Claude message; the rest says nothing about how long a session has been quiet
evidence: reducer test walks each input; hub restart test

decision: lastActiveAt is stored with the session; after a restart a running session takes the transcript's last entry when it is newer, and a state file from before falls back to lastTurnEndedAt, then createdAt
why: a turn that ends while the hub is down reaches nobody through the hooks; every stored session already had lastTurnEndedAt, so no transcript is read for offline ones
evidence: store and restart tests; live: restored times spread from 0 to 137 h while stateSince was 0.3 min for all

decision: the session list and the folders are ordered by lastActiveAt too
why: a restart reshuffled the list into path order, and opening a session moved it up
evidence: app ordering test fails on the old code

decision: memoryReport is a request the screen polls every 5 s, not a field broadcast with each session
why: exact figures with swap and the sessions outside orfoni, with no extra sessionUpdated churn for the rows

decision: swap is a large share of what idle sessions hold
why: 13 orfoni sessions held 6.7 GB of 12 GB swap; demo-focus 352 MB RAM and 2.7 GB swap, idle 6 days; the row showed nothing since it reads memory.current only

decision: a session's figures add in its shells
why: Stop ends the shells too, so the figure is what Stop frees

decision: a session outside orfoni gets figures only when its process runs in a tmux-spawn-*.scope
why: a Claude Code started straight from an SSH login shares its cgroup with the whole login, which would overstate it
evidence: hub test with a session-3.scope process

decision: RAM is memory.current, page cache included, not anon
why: it is what counts against the pane's limit and what the header shows; the sessions here are mostly anon anyway
evidence: measured 2026-11-06: anon was 90 to 96% of memory.current in 10 of 13 sessions, and 42 to 72% in the other three

decision: Stop in the list is disabled while a session works or waits on you, and works for an offline session with shells
why: the header's Stop has no confirmation, and a list of Stop buttons invites a stray click that would end a turn

decision: no Stop for sessions outside orfoni on the screen
why: the design keeps orfoni from disturbing a pane it did not start; Port into orfoni stays the way in

decision: no bulk stop, such as every session idle for a day
why: not asked for, and one click per session is already enough to stay on top

decision: the screen in the Windows and Android apps
why: needs a release; the browser build was checked at 1400 px and 400 px against the live hub
